parameters.description: Place holder for Token based authentication

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Date till which Statement has to be generated (Date format : YYYYMMDD)

parameters.name: transactionPosType
parameters.description: Transaction Pos Type (Domain name : d_PosTyp , CD value : 5290000, Example Value : 126 - AME, 316 - Cash Block)

parameters.description: TransactionType - Indicates the type of transcation done. 1-Credit, 2-Debit

crsSubClassification.description: This field will have values depending upon Value of CRS Classification Selection.1.When CRS Classification is chosen as 06: Non-Reporting Financial Institution under CRS, then CRS Sub Classification is populated as-(01-Governmental Entity,02-International Organization,03-Central Bank,04-Broad Participation Retirement Fund,05-Narrow Participation Retirement Fund,06-Pension Fund of a Governmental Entity, International Organization, or Central Bank,07-Exempt Collective Investment Vehicle,08-Trust whose trustee reports all required information with respect to all CRS Reportable Accounts,09-Qualified Credit Card Issuer,10: Other Entity defined under the domestic law as low risk of being used to evade tax).2. When CRS Classification is chosen as 04: Investment Entity, then CRS Sub Classification is populated as-(01- Type A-Gross income primarily (more than 50%) from business investment activities (trading/investing in Financial Assets, portfolio management, investing/administering/managing FA/funds) on behalf of customers,02-Type B-Gross income primarily (more than 50%) from investment in Financial Assets and managed by a Financial Institution).3. When CRS Classification is chosen as 12-Active NFE Other than 4 through 6 above, then CRS Sub Classification is populated as-(01-Active NFE by reason of income and assets.02-Holding NFE that is a member of a nonfinancial group.03-Treasury Center NFE that is a member of a nonfinancial group.04-Start-up NFE (Date of Organization),05-NFE that is liquidating or emerging from bankruptcy.06-Non-profit NFE)

validFrom.description: The date since when the Currency linkage to the Corporate Scheme will be considered as valid.(Date Format: YYYYMMDD)

operationalUnit.description: Current Operational Unit in Virtual Account System in which User is logged in

faClassification.description: The FA classification of the account as defined in the Financial Accounting module for the instrument-currency combination

accountSequence.description: Account Sequence denotes the Sequence of the Virtual Account which will be generated based on Seed Number defined in Account Scheme for that Corporate Scheme

virtualIbanNumber.description: On the basis of account numbering scheme, the Virtual Account IBAN will be generated and shown in this field

virtualBbanNumber.description: On the basis of account numbering scheme, the Virtual Account BBAN will be generated and shown in this field

accountReference1.description: On the basis of account numbering scheme, the Virtual Account Reference 1 will be generated and shown in this field. If no scheme has been defined, it can be manually captured

accountReference2.description: On the basis of account numbering scheme, the Virtual Account Reference 2 will be generated and shown in this field. If no scheme has been defined, it can be manually captured

parentAccountCategory.description: Indicator to denote the type of Credit Account Reference of parent account.If User selects (1-Real), Parent Account Reference will be fetched from Physical Account Database.If User selects (2-Virtual), Parent Account Reference will be fetched from Virtual Account Database

parentAccountReference.description: This filed denotes Physical Bank Account or virtual account that will be the immediate parent of the account being created.

hierarchyName.description: Name of the Hierarchy of which if Parent Account Reference defined, is a part of. If Hierarchy Name provided,Virtual Account getting Created will become part of that Virtual Account Hierarchy

openedOn.description: Date on which the account is opened(Format : YYYYMMDD)

closedOn.description: date on which the account is Closed(Format : YYYYMMDD)

remarks.description: Any remarks or additional information that needs to be provided

manualEntriesAllowed.description: This flag indicates that manual entry (for adjustments) is allowed on the account

provenance.description: Mode from which the account is being created(1-Backoffice,Branch Corporate Channel)

languagePreference.description: It denotes the language of correspondence for the account

levelId.description: It denotes the field reference for which the virtual account will be created.The level id is fetched from the Account Scheme combination which is defined for the specified virtual account

levelValue.description: The user is mandatorily required to provide the values of different levels as defined in the virtual account numbering schema so that a unique virtual account number can be generated. This folder will be enabled only when the user has provided the values of all other mandatory fields on the screen

levelFormat.description: Level format denotes the Data type of the Level Value which is getting defined for a Particular Level Id
